scope: Prospective Aya-only analysis of source-checked external Arabic and Hebrew cohorts; defined before model results
primary_estimand: Within each language separately, mean per-answer-stratum paired difference in gold-minus-frozen-distractor total log likelihood (marked minus unmarked), t1 prompt. Negative means marking worsens relative support for the correct answer.
unit_of_independence: Distinct subject QID. For the macro estimand, answer strata are country ISO2 for Arabic and official subdistrict name for Hebrew.

inference.two_sided_cluster_sign_flip: Flip the signs of answer-stratum mean paired effects. Enumerate all flips when there are at most 18 strata; otherwise use 200000 Monte Carlo flips with plus-one correction.
inference.multiple_testing: Holm adjustment over the two primary language tests.
inference.hierarchical_bootstrap: Sample answer strata with replacement, then subjects within selected strata with replacement; 10000 replicates, percentile 95% interval.

secondary: Repeat the paired-margin effect with t2 wording.
Report subject-weighted paired margin change beside the answer-macro result.
Report canonical gold-answer likelihood change to compare with prior E2 results.
Report strict full-answer generation accuracy and deterministic prefix-stripped rematch separately; do not label uncaught paraphrases as definitively wrong.
For the Arabic cohort, report English-control exact answer recall as a descriptive pre-specified knowledge screen.
Report first-name token counts and full prompt counts without treating count associations as causal evidence.
restrictions: Keep the pilot, first heldout, and Google-RE results as separate prior cohorts.
Do not compare Arabic and Hebrew absolute accuracies as if their source relations and answer sets were matched.
Do not describe Wikipedia/Wikidata source checks as independent speaker review.
Do not claim E6 or the new data isolate token count, spelling, and identity fully.
